Explicit analytic prerequisite restatement:
E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with Borel measurable structure and canonical full-space volume, including dimension zero. W is C1 and exp(-W) is genuinely integrable for volume; mu is exactly volume.tilted(-W).
D is the same real-linear partial gradient on actual L2(mu), closable with original graph exactly compact smooth scalar representatives and their genuine gradients, identified mu-a.e. Epsilon is positive and forcing f is a genuine scalar L2(mu) class. Neither a weak solution, test-domain membership, ordinary PDE nor local-L2 certificate is supplied.
All ordinary weak derivatives, compact restrictions and distribution test integrals use volume; the variational identity uses actual L2(mu). The actual closed gradient G=D.closure u and the same u serve every test/compact. C2 compact tests suffice; no regularity of the selected L2 representative u is assumed.
For actual mu=volume.tilted(-W), the same exact closable compact smooth gradient D, every epsilon>0 and genuine L2(mu) forcing f, construct u in D.closure.domain satisfying the all-domain variational equation. Its actual G=D.closure u is the ordinary weak gradient, with locally volume-integrable u/G and every C1 compact directional identity and both integrable products. Put k=epsilon u+inner(gradient W,G)-f. Prove locally integrable squared norm of k and actual u/G/k in L2(volume.restrict K) for every compact K. For every C2 compact phi, both u Delta phi and k phi are integrable for volume and integral u Delta phi = integral k phi. This is a distribution identity, not a classical Laplacian of arbitrary u.
Same actual D/u/G and forcing yield ordinary volume distribution Delta u=epsilon u+inner(gradient W,G)-f, all C2 compact tests with genuine L1 products, and genuine local L2 of u/G/right-hand side. Full existing variational and ordinary weak-gradient identities retained. Actual PBPS R/S/reflected law and fixed fiber D before epsilon/input. No local H2, global generator core/Bochner, Poincare/BL, centered epsilon limit, noncompact constant/linear domains, measurable y-selection, SPHMC Hessian lower/full4.1 or complete paper/main/composition. TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.

(W : E → ℝ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 W)
    (hI : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W x))) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -W x)
    ∀ (D : Lp ℝ 2 μ →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 μ), D.IsClosable →
      (∀ (a : Lp ℝ 2 μ) (H : Lp E 2 μ), (a,H) ∈ D.graph ↔
        ∃ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧
          a =ᵐ[μ] φ ∧ H =ᵐ[μ] gradient φ) →
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 μ,
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 μ), (v : Lp ℝ 2 μ)⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 μ)⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x +
          inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ K : Set E, IsCompact K →
          MemLp (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => D.closure u x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x) 2 (volume.restrict K)) ∧
        ∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
          (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) =
            ∫ x, (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x +
              inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x
decoder_context: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with Borel measurable space and canonical Lebesgue volume, including dimension zero. All section ambient instances remain part of the contract. NNReal means nonnegative real scalars.

Lp F 2 mu is the true L2 quotient and its coercion selects the standard measurable representative. MemLp is actual a.e. strong measurability and finite L2 norm. All compact restrictions in the statement use volume.restrict K, and all unannotated local integrability/integrals use canonical volume.

gradient is the Riesz representative of actual Frechet derivative; fderiv is total Lean derivative. Laplacian.laplacian phi is the actual test-function finite-basis trace. The theorem only tests arbitrary L2 u against this smooth-test Laplacian, and does not assert pointwise total laplacian u.

LinearPMap is a real-linear partial operator on its submodule domain, with actual graph. IsClosable means its topological graph closure is single-valued. D.closure is that same closed operator. Its L2 output is the actual G representative appearing in the ordinary distribution equation.

Measure.tilted h means exp(h)/integral exp(h) times the original measure; it does not build in positive normalization. Kernel IsMarkovKernel means genuine measurable probability transitions. IsCondKernel is true disintegration of the stated joint measure. Measure.map/prod mean actual pushforward/independent product. stdGaussian is the genuine standard real Hilbert Gaussian. ContDiff 1/2/infinity means C1/C2/smooth; HasCompactSupport is compact topological support.

/- Actual ordinary distribution equation of the same weighted weak resolvent.
The conclusion is tested against compact C2 functions; no classical Laplacian
of the arbitrary L2 representative or H2/domain-core certificate is assumed. -/
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedResolventC1
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedLocalL2
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Laplacian

set_option autoImplicit false
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory InnerProductSpace
open scoped ContDiff NNReal RealInnerProductSpace Topology
noncomputable section
namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.OrdinaryWeakResolvent
variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]

private theorem inverseweight_gradient (W φ : E → ℝ)
    (hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 W) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ) (x G : E) :
    Real.exp (-W x) * inner ℝ G (gradient (fun z => Real.exp (W z) * φ z) x) =
      φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) G + inner ℝ G (gradient φ x) := by
  rw [inner_gradient_right, inner_gradient_right]
  simp only [conj_trivial]
  have hd := ((hW.differentiable one_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt.exp).mul
    (hφ.differentiable one_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
  rw [show fderiv ℝ (fun z => Real.exp (W z) * φ z) x = _ from hd.fderiv]
  simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp only [inner_gradient_left]
  have he : Real.exp (-W x) * Real.exp (W x) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  calc
    _ = (Real.exp (-W x) * Real.exp (W x)) *
      (φ x * fderiv ℝ W x G + fderiv ℝ φ x G) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he, one_mul]

private theorem locally_integrable_inner_const (G : E → E)
    (hG : LocallyIntegrable G) (v : E) :
    LocallyIntegrable (fun x => inner ℝ (G x) v) := by
  rw [← locallyIntegrableOn_univ] at hG ⊢
  have h := (innerSL ℝ v).locallyIntegrableOn_comp hG
  change LocallyIntegrableOn (fun x => inner ℝ v (G x)) Set.univ volume at h
  simpa only [real_inner_comm] using h

private theorem locally_integrable_inner (G B : E → E)
    (hG : LocallyIntegrable G) (hB : Continuous B) :
    LocallyIntegrable (fun x => inner ℝ (G x) (B x)) := by
  have he (x : E) := (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E).sum_inner_mul_inner (G x) (B x)
  simp_rw [← he]
  apply locallyIntegrable_finsetSum
  intro i _
  exact (locally_integrable_inner_const G hG _).mul_continuous
    (continuous_const.inner hB)

private theorem lp_inner_continuous_local_l2 (W : E → ℝ)
    (hW : Continuous W) (hI : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W x)))
    (G : Lp E 2 ((volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -W x)))
    (B : E → E) (hB : Continuous B) (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    MemLp (fun x => inner ℝ (B x) (G x)) 2 (volume.restrict K) := by
  have hG := (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedLocalL2.lp_locallyMemLp_volume W hW hI G).2 K hK
  obtain ⟨C,hC⟩ := hK.bddAbove_image (hB.norm.continuousOn)
  apply hG.of_le_mul (c := C) (hB.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict.inner hG.aestronglyMeasurable)
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem hK.measurableSet] with x hx
  exact (norm_inner_le_norm _ _).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hC (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hx)) (norm_nonneg _))

private theorem ordinary_weak_laplacian (u : E → ℝ) (G : E → E)
    (hderiv : ∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
      Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (G x) v) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => u x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
      (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (G x) v) = - ∫ x, u x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v)
    (φ : E → ℝ) (hφ : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ) (hc : HasCompactSupport φ) :
    Integrable (fun x => u x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
    Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (G x) (gradient φ x)) ∧
    (∫ x, u x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) = - ∫ x, inner ℝ (G x) (gradient φ x) := by
  let b := stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ E
  have hφ2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 φ := hφ
  let ψ := fun i x => fderiv ℝ φ x (b i)
  have hψ (i) : ContDiff ℝ 1 (ψ i) :=
    (hφ2.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hψc (i) : HasCompactSupport (ψ i) := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.of_support_subset_isCompact hc.isCompact ?_
    intro x hx
    by_contra hn
    exact hx (by simp [ψ, fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport ℝ hn])
  have hd (i) := hderiv (ψ i) (hψ i) (hψc i) (b i)
  have hd2 (x v : E) :
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ φ z v) x v = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) x v v := by
    have h := ((hφ2.fderiv_right (m := 1) (by norm_num)).differentiable one_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
    have he := h.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const v x)
    simpa using congrArg (fun T : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => T v) he.fderiv
  have hLap (x : E) : Laplacian.laplacian φ x = ∑ i, fderiv ℝ (ψ i) x (b i) := by
    rw [InnerProductSpace.laplacian_eq_iteratedFDeriv_stdOrthonormalBasis]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    dsimp [ψ,b]
    rw [hd2, iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    rfl
  have hInner (x : E) : inner ℝ (G x) (gradient φ x) =
      ∑ i, ψ i x * inner ℝ (G x) (b i) := by
    rw [← b.sum_inner_mul_inner (G x) (gradient φ x)]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [inner_gradient_right]
    simp only [conj_trivial]
    dsimp [ψ]
    ring
  have hLi : Integrable (fun x => u x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) := by
    simp_rw [hLap, Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hd i).2.1)
  have hGi : Integrable (fun x => inner ℝ (G x) (gradient φ x)) := by
    simp_rw [hInner]
    exact integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hd i).1)
  refine ⟨hLi,hGi,?_⟩
  simp_rw [hLap, Finset.mul_sum, hInner]
  rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hd i).2.1),
      integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => (hd i).1)]
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  linarith [(hd i).2.2]

theorem weak_resolvent_laplacian (W : E → ℝ) (hW : ContDiff ℝ 1 W)
    (hI : Integrable (fun x => Real.exp (-W x))) :
    let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -W x)
    ∀ (D : Lp ℝ 2 μ →ₗ.[ℝ] Lp E 2 μ), D.IsClosable →
      (∀ (a : Lp ℝ 2 μ) (H : Lp E 2 μ), (a,H) ∈ D.graph ↔
        ∃ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧
          a =ᵐ[μ] φ ∧ H =ᵐ[μ] gradient φ) →
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 μ,
      ∃ u : D.closure.domain,
        (∀ v : D.closure.domain,
          ε * ⟪(u : Lp ℝ 2 μ), (v : Lp ℝ 2 μ)⟫ +
            ⟪D.closure u, D.closure v⟫ = ⟪f, (v : Lp ℝ 2 μ)⟫) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => D.closure u x) ∧
        (∀ ψ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → ∀ v : E,
          Integrable (fun x => ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
          (∫ x, ψ x * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) v) =
            - ∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * fderiv ℝ ψ x v) ∧
        LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x +
          inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x‖ ^ 2) ∧
        (∀ K : Set E, IsCompact K →
          MemLp (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => D.closure u x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
          MemLp (fun x => ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x) 2 (volume.restrict K)) ∧
        ∀ φ : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 2 φ → HasCompactSupport φ →
          Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) ∧
          Integrable (fun x => (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x +
            inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x) ∧
          (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) =
            ∫ x, (ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x +
              inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x) * φ x := by
  let μ := (volume : Measure E).tilted (fun x => -W x)
  dsimp only
  intro D hD hgraph ε hε f
  obtain ⟨u,hu,huL,hGL,hderiv,hweighted⟩ :=
    AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedResolventC1.weak_resolvent_c1 W hW hI D hD hgraph ε hε f
  have hgrad : Continuous (gradient W) :=
    (toDual ℝ E).symm.continuous.comp (hW.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero)
  let r := fun x => ε * (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x + inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x
  have hlocal (K : Set E) (hK : IsCompact K) :
      MemLp (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
      MemLp (fun x => D.closure u x) 2 (volume.restrict K) ∧
      MemLp r 2 (volume.restrict K) := by
    have hU := (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedLocalL2.lp_locallyMemLp_volume W hW.continuous hI (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ)).2 K hK
    have hG := (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedLocalL2.lp_locallyMemLp_volume W hW.continuous hI (D.closure u)).2 K hK
    have hF := (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedLocalL2.lp_locallyMemLp_volume W hW.continuous hI f).2 K hK
    have hB := lp_inner_continuous_local_l2 W hW.continuous hI (D.closure u) (gradient W) hgrad K hK
    refine ⟨hU,hG,?_⟩
    convert ((hU.const_smul ε).add hB).sub hF using 1
    funext x
    rfl
  have hr2 : LocallyIntegrable (fun x => ‖r x‖^2) := by
    rw [locallyIntegrable_iff]
    intro K hK
    have hr := (hlocal K hK).2.2
    exact (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hr.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hr
  have hfL : LocallyIntegrable (fun x => f x) := by
    rw [locallyIntegrable_iff]
    intro K hK
    let : IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict K) := isFiniteMeasure_restrict.mpr hK.measure_lt_top.ne
    have hF := (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.WeightedLocalL2.lp_locallyMemLp_volume W hW.continuous hI f).2 K hK
    exact hF.integrable (by norm_num)
  have hBLoc : LocallyIntegrable (fun x => inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x)) := by
    simpa only [real_inner_comm] using locally_integrable_inner _ _ hGL hgrad
  have hrLoc : LocallyIntegrable r := by
    convert ((huL.smul ε).add hBLoc).sub hfL using 1
    funext x
    rfl
  refine ⟨u,hu,huL,hGL,hderiv,hr2,hlocal,?_⟩
  intro φ hφ hc
  have hφ1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 φ := hφ.of_le (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨hLapI,hGi,hLap⟩ := ordinary_weak_laplacian _ _ hderiv φ hφ hc
  have hRi : Integrable (fun x => r x * φ x) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hrLoc.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport hφ1.continuous hc
  refine ⟨hLapI,hRi,?_⟩
  let ψ := fun x => Real.exp (W x) * φ x
  have hψ : ContDiff ℝ 1 ψ := hW.exp.mul hφ1
  have hψc : HasCompactSupport ψ := hc.mul_left
  have hw := (hweighted ψ hψ hψc).2.2.2
  have hcancel (x : E) : Real.exp (-W x) * Real.exp (W x) = 1 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]; simp
  have hfirst (a : E → ℝ) (x : E) : Real.exp (-W x) * (a x * ψ x) = a x * φ x := by
    dsimp [ψ]
    calc
      _ = (Real.exp (-W x) * Real.exp (W x)) * (a x * φ x) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hcancel,one_mul]
  have hsecond (x : E) : Real.exp (-W x) * inner ℝ (D.closure u x) (gradient ψ x) =
      φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) + inner ℝ (D.closure u x) (gradient φ x) :=
    inverseweight_gradient W φ hW hφ1 x (D.closure u x)
  simp only [hfirst,hsecond] at hw
  have hUi : Integrable (fun x => (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * φ x) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using huL.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport hφ1.continuous hc
  have hBi : Integrable (fun x => φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x)) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hBLoc.integrable_smul_left_of_hasCompactSupport hφ1.continuous hc
  have hFi : Integrable (fun x => f x * φ x) := by
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using hfL.integrable_smul_right_of_hasCompactSupport hφ1.continuous hc
  rw [integral_add hBi hGi] at hw
  have he : (∫ x, r x * φ x) =
      ε * (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * φ x) +
      (∫ x, φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x)) - ∫ x, f x * φ x := by
    have hp : (fun x => r x * φ x) = (fun x =>
      ε * ((u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * φ x) + φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) - f x * φ x) := by
      funext x; dsimp [r]; ring
    have hsum : Integrable (fun x => ε * ((u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * φ x) + φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x)) := by
      convert (hUi.const_mul ε).add hBi using 1 <;> rfl
    have hsumEq : (∫ x, ε * ((u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * φ x) + φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x)) =
        ε * (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * φ x) + ∫ x, φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) := by
      calc
        _ = (∫ x, ε * ((u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * φ x)) + ∫ x, φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x) :=
          integral_add (hUi.const_mul ε) hBi
        _ = _ := by rw [integral_const_mul]
    rw [hp]
    calc
      _ = (∫ x, ε * ((u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * φ x) + φ x * inner ℝ (gradient W x) (D.closure u x)) - ∫ x, f x * φ x :=
        integral_sub hsum hFi
      _ = _ := by rw [hsumEq]
  change (∫ x, (u : Lp ℝ 2 μ) x * Laplacian.laplacian φ x) = ∫ x, r x * φ x
  rw [he]
  linarith [hLap,hw]

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.FunctionalInequalities.OrdinaryWeakResolvent

lesson.statement: For actual mu=volume.tilted(-W), the same exact closable compact smooth gradient D, every epsilon>0 and genuine L2(mu) forcing f, construct u in D.closure.domain satisfying the all-domain variational equation. Its actual G=D.closure u is the ordinary weak gradient, with locally volume-integrable u/G and every C1 compact directional identity and both integrable products. Put k=epsilon u+inner(gradient W,G)-f. Prove locally integrable squared norm of k and actual u/G/k in L2(volume.restrict K) for every compact K. For every C2 compact phi, both u Delta phi and k phi are integrable for volume and integral u Delta phi = integral k phi. This is a distribution identity, not a classical Laplacian of arbitrary u.
lesson.formula: \mu=Z_W^{-1}e^{-W}dx,\quad G=\overline Du,\quad k=\varepsilon u+\langle\nabla W,G\rangle-f;\quad u,G,k\in L^2_{\rm loc}(dx),\quad\int u\Delta\phi\,dx=\int k\phi\,dx\ (\phi\in C_c^2).

steps.title: Retain the same genuine weak solution and ordinary weak gradient
steps.text: Apply the canonical C1 resolvent to the actual normalized law and original closable graph. It supplies u in the same closure domain, its all-domain variational equation, ordinary locally integrable representatives, and every C1 compact directional weak-gradient identity. No Poisson/Poincare or final-PDE premise is inserted.
steps.formula: \varepsilon\langle u,v\rangle_{L^2(\mu)}+\langle G,\overline Dv\rangle_{L^2(\mu)}=\langle f,v\rangle_{L^2(\mu)},\quad G=\overline Du.

steps.title: Derive actual compact-volume L2 and the drift bound
steps.text: The true weighted L2 classes u/G/f each transfer to volume L2 on every compact K by the existing local producer. Continuous grad W is bounded on K by a constant M_K. Its actual a.e. measurable drift product obeys abs(inner(grad W,G))<=M_K norm G on the restricted measure. MemLp domination and addition give actual k compact L2; the squared-norm criterion gives locally integrable norm(k)^2. M_K depends on K and is not a global drift bound.
steps.formula: u,G,f\in L^2(K,dx),\quad|\langle\nabla W,G\rangle|\le M_K\|G\|,\quad k\in L^2(K,dx).

steps.title: Use a legitimate inverseweight test and genuine product rule
steps.text: For C2 compact phi, psi=exp(W)phi is still compact and C1 when W is only C1. Differentiate the actual product by Frechet/Riesz calculus. True exponential cancellation converts its weighted gradient term into phi inner(grad W,G)+inner(G,grad phi); multiplying by exp(W) does not remove compact support.

steps.title: Derive the weak Laplacian by finite-basis summation
steps.text: For each orthonormal basis vector b_i, chi_i=Dphi[b_i] is C1 compact. Apply the genuine ordinary weak-gradient identity in direction b_i. The actual second Frechet derivative identifies Delta phi with sum_i Dchi_i[b_i], and Riesz/orthonormal expansion identifies inner(G,grad phi) with sum_i chi_i inner(G,b_i). Each term is integrable before exchanging the finite sum and integral. Empty basis sums cover dimension zero.
steps.formula: \int u\Delta\phi\,dx=\sum_i\int uD\chi_i[b_i]dx=-\sum_i\int\chi_i\langle G,b_i\rangle dx=-\int\langle G,\nabla\phi\rangle dx.

steps.title: Justify every ordinary integral before combining the equations
steps.text: Local integrability of u/f and continuous-drift product, together with compact continuous phi, proves the individual ordinary u phi, drift phi and f phi products L1. The preceding finite-basis step proves the gradient and Laplace products L1. Use the actual weighted C1 equation at psi and cancel only the true pointwise exp(-W)exp(W)=1. Legal integral addition/subtraction yields integral k phi=-integral inner(G,grad phi).

reconstruction.text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real inner-product space with its Borel measurable space and canonical Lebesgue measure dx; dimension zero is allowed, and the approved ambient instances are part of the contract. Let W:E->R be C1 and assume x->exp(-W(x)) is Lebesgue integrable. Define mu=volume.tilted(x->-W(x)), namely exp(-W)/integral exp(-W) times volume; positivity of its normalizing integral is not built into the definition.
For every real-linear partial operator D:L2(mu;R)->L2(mu;E), assume D is closable and has exactly the following graph: for every a in L2(mu;R) and H in L2(mu;E), (a,H) belongs to graph(D) if and only if there exists a smooth compactly supported phi:E->R with a=phi mu-almost everywhere and H=gradient(phi) mu-almost everywhere. The closure is the same operator defined by the topological graph closure, on its submodule domain.
For every real epsilon>0 and every scalar L2 input f for this same D, there exists u in domain(D.closure) satisfying the following simultaneous conclusions. Write u_rep and f_rep for the standard measurable representatives of the actual scalar L2 classes, and G_rep for the standard representative of G=D.closure(u) in the actual vector L2 quotient. In the formulas below set r(x)=epsilon*u_rep(x)+<gradient(W)(x),G_rep(x)>_E-f_rep(x); this notation abbreviates the exact displayed expression.
(1) For every v in domain(D.closure),
  epsilon*<u,v>_{L2(mu;R)}+<D.closure(u),D.closure(v)>_{L2(mu;E)}=<f,v>_{L2(mu;R)}.
(2) u_rep and G_rep are locally integrable with respect to canonical Lebesgue volume.
(3) For every C1 compactly supported psi:E->R and every direction v in E, both x->psi(x)*<G_rep(x),v>_E and x->u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x v) are Lebesgue integrable, and
  integral psi(x)*<G_rep(x),v>_E dx = - integral u_rep(x)*(fderiv R psi x v) dx.
(4) x->||r(x)||^2 is locally Lebesgue integrable, with the real scalar norm in this squared expression.
(5) For every compact set K contained in E, u_rep, G_rep, and r each satisfy MemLp with exponent 2 and the actual restricted measure volume.restrict K. Each assertion includes a.e. strong measurability and finite L2 norm with respect to that restricted measure.
(6) For every C2 compactly supported phi:E->R, both x->u_rep(x)*Laplacian.laplacian(phi)(x) and x->r(x)*phi(x) are Lebesgue integrable, and
  integral u_rep(x)*Laplacian.laplacian(phi)(x) dx = integral r(x)*phi(x) dx.
Here the test-function Laplacian is the actual finite-basis trace of its derivative. The distribution equation tests u_rep against this C2 test Laplacian; it makes no pointwise total-Laplacian assertion about u_rep. The Hilbert variational inner products use mu, while all local integrability and distribution integrals use canonical Lebesgue volume. One u and its actual output G serve all variational v, all C1 directional tests, every compact K, and all C2 distribution tests.
The operator D is quantified before epsilon and f and works for all their permitted values. Its density or existence is not an additional premise or an existential conclusion of this universal implication. The exact forcing expression is epsilon*u_rep+<gradient(W),G_rep>-f_rep. There is no mean-zero restriction on f, no C2 assumption on W, and no classical differentiability or H2 regularity conclusion for u_rep. The statement asserts existence of such u, without a uniqueness, quantitative bound, or jointly measurable selection conclusion.
